test_case.test_name: Peak TOPS — retained pending authoritative measurement contract
test_case.purpose: Measure the approved GPU peak operations rate for the exact SKU, precision, dense/sparse and accumulation semantics and compare it with the authoritative reference while proving clocks, power, thermal and error state remain acceptable.
required_package: Authoritative project/vendor Peak TOPS SPEC and approved reference revision (including whether DA-10997-001_v31/Viking applies)
Named tool provenance/version/checksum/license, exact command/configuration and compatible GPU/driver/firmware/CUDA stack
GPU SKU/UUID/BDF plus precision, sparsity, accumulation, operation-count formula and workload/tensor dimensions
Warmup, repetition, 100-minute schedule, statistic, units, numeric floor/tolerance and allowed throttling
Cooling/power/PSU/OOB, clock/throttle/XID/AER hard stops, cooldown and recovery
test_case.test_command: Do not select or run a benchmark from the title alone. After the owner publishes the authoritative tool/profile and score oracle, preserve baseline logs and GPU/platform telemetry, execute only that pinned Peak TOPS workload for the approved warmup/repetition/time profile under hard stops, retain every raw score and calculation, then cool down and verify restored health.
test_case.expected_result: The future approved workload completes for every required sample; raw operations and elapsed-time data produce the declared TOPS statistic using the signed formula; the statistic meets the authoritative SKU floor/tolerance; clocks and power mode match the reference and no disqualifying throttle, thermal, power, XID, AER or platform event occurs.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: No PASS is possible while the tool/profile, precision/sparsity/formula, reference and numeric floor are absent. A reported TOPS number, tool exit success or comparison across different semantics is insufficient; after approval, the end engineer evaluates the full score distribution and synchronized health evidence.
safety_gate: Gate closed until authoritative SPEC, tool/config, numeric oracle and owner approval exist
Drain other workloads; verify stable cooling, redundant power and independent OOB before maximum compute
Preserve logs and monitor clocks, throttle reasons, power, thermal, fan/PSU, XID and AER
Abort on any signed limit or undefined behavior, cool down and never retry automatically
expected_evidence: Every raw score, operation/time calculation and distribution-versus-floor result
test_case.recovery: If a future approved run throttles, exceeds limits, errors or loses reachability, terminate the workload without retry, preserve all raw scores and first-fault telemetry, use OOB to confirm state, cool down, isolate the affected GPU/power/cooling path and restore only approved clock/power/runtime settings.
